## Description {#details}

<p>This <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/sdnode">SDNode</a> is used for target intrinsics that touch memory and need an associated <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/machinememoperand">MachineMemOperand</a>.</p>


<p>Its opcode may be INTRINSIC_VOID, INTRINSIC_W_CHAIN, PREFETCH, or a target-specific memory-referencing opcode (see <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/selectiondagtargetinfo/#a3c0c3b26a895016d5ee61ee67b858e1c">SelectionDAGTargetInfo::isTargetMemoryOpcode</a></span>).</p>


<p>Definition at line 1601 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/codegen/selectiondagnodes-h">SelectionDAGNodes.h</a>.</p>
